summary: Reconcile repository-local Planfile delivery with target-owned ticket activity and integration ownership

delivery.outcome: Deliver the tracked Planfile store with a canonical ticket carrier, target-owned missing-receipt policy, and explicit integration ownership for the Planfile governance contract.
nonGoals: No application code, runtime behavior, or application tests are changed.
No terminal receipt is fabricated and no ticket status projection is edited.
No remote branch, pull request, merge, tag, or release is performed by the repository commit itself.

architecture.decision: Keep Planfile data non-operational, resolve missing terminal receipts through the supported target-owned git-ancestry override, and place both contracts under the integration workstream.
dataChanges: Adds the target-owned ticket activity policy override.
Declares integration ownership for the repository-local Planfile contract.
Adds the canonical ticket-003 intent and execution handoff carrier.
architecture.rollback: Revert this ticket branch; preserve the prior remote PR head as the recorded backup ref until the protected controller completes publication.

validation.evidence: The Planfile mapping and strict target-owned policy are present and parseable.
The managed governance gate accepts one active ticket and explicit integration ownership.
The repository test suite remains green without application changes.
